items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: We’d do these shows with Stevie Wonder and Gladys Knight & the Pips and Wilson Pickett, Al Green, all of these really heavy soul acts.

ctx.x: She was in a very high period in her career, right?

Oh boy, that was really — because then I was back in R&B again, which was really — oh I thought oh this, in R&B I was making more than eleven dollars a night. She was a sweetheart, I mean boy oh boy, was she ever a nice woman. Because I had my first wife, she was — sometimes Dionne would just take her along with us. And we traveled all over the place. And great shows. We’d do these shows with Stevie Wonder and Gladys Knight & the Pips and Wilson Pickett, Al Green, all of these really heavy soul acts. And it was…
